name: Speak with our Quartermaster
label: Quest
description: Speak with our Quartermaster: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, the Frostwolf Quartermaster is looking for recruits, for tasks that lead into the mines of Alterac Valley. Speak with him; he will tell you more.
Follow the road west into the bunker, then take the west exit and you'll find our quartermaster.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hail, friend! It is good to see an adventurer like yourself, eager to do their part for the Horde. Speak with me again, for I have vital tasks for you...
